description: SAMPLE. The security role matrix as code: per role, per table, which privilege at which depth. build/New-SecurityRoles.ps1 applies it to a DEVELOPMENT environment (adds what is missing, reports what is extra, never removes a privilege someone added by hand unless -Prune); the roles then travel in the solution. tests/contracts/roles.test.mjs fails when a table in schema.json has no row here, when a role names a table or privilege that does not exist, or when a depth is not one of the four. Depth names are the Web API's: Basic (the user's own rows), Local (the business unit), Deep (business unit and below), Global (the organisation). Role names are not translated by Dataverse: name roles in the base language. Least privilege first: start from nothing and add what the job needs; never copy System Administrator or Basic User.

roles.name: CaseApp Caseworker
roles.description: Handles requests in their own business unit. Cannot delete.

roles.name: CaseApp Team Lead
roles.description: Everything a caseworker does, across the business unit and the units below it, and may share and delete.

roles.name: CaseApp Reader
roles.description: Reads requests across the organisation, changes nothing. For management and audit.

noRole.$comment: Tables in schema.json that deliberately get no privileges in any product role, with the reason. Empty in the sample.
